description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I: Garland] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I: Garland
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Dark abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II: Garland], removes [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I: Garland]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II: Garland
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%, grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 1] to all allies with any Attach Dark after using Dark abilities

description.name: Deadly Strikes +10% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 10% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
